# Instagram Followers and Following Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-followers-following-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-followers-following-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.174**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Instagram followers' names. Just add Instagram profile and extract followers' username, name, profile picture URL, private or public status, verified status and Instagram user ID. Export scraped data, schedule scraper via API, and integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Profile $0.002 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-followers-following-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-followers-following-scraper@0.0.174#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      usernames: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `usernames` | array | yes |  | Instagram usernames — Public Instagram usernames (without @) whose followers or following you want to scrape. Use the &#43; Add button to add more usernames. |
| `dataToScrape` | string |  | `"followers"` | Data to scrape — What do you want to scrape from each account? |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Maximum results per username — Maximum number of followers or following to scrape per username. If you set it to 5, you'll get 5 followers/following for each profile you've included. ⚠️ Free usage covers just the first page of results. To get more pages, Upgrade your plan (https://console.apify.com/ |
